scripts.build:production: pnpm --filter @propertymaster/database build && test -f packages/database/dist/index.js && pnpm --filter @propertymaster/shared build && pnpm --filter @propertymaster/frontend-admin build && pnpm --filter @propertymaster/frontend-tenant build && pnpm --filter @propertymaster/backend build
scripts.db:generate: cd packages/database && PRISMA_ENGINES_CHECKSUM_IGNORE_MISSING=1 npx prisma generate
scripts.db:push: cd packages/database && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd packages/database && (npx prisma migrate resolve --applied "20241124000000_initial_schema" || true) && (npx prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back "20241202000000_add_vendor_approval_workflow" || true) && npx prisma migrate deploy
